title: Turkle conversation erosion loop
summary: Technology mediation trains fragmented attention, which erodes the skills of face-to-face conversation and, with them, empathy: Turkle's conversation crisis and empathy deficit. New cultural norms (device-free zones, intentional use) are the missing coordination.
source: Ch09 §9.3 — Turkle interview; "technology coordinates with our habits in ways that make us worse at human connection."

nodes.label: Fragmented Attention
nodes.description: Trained by constant stimulation and speed

nodes.label: Conversation Skill
nodes.description: Sustained attention, tolerance for silence, vulnerability

edges.description: Conversation builds relational resilience and empathy
Norms such as device-free zones protect attention

identifiability_note: Norms (n5) shape both exposure and attention; the size of the technology effect on empathy cannot be separated from them observationally.
